brief: When the page loads, a red count bubble pops in just under the cart icon in the top bar.
defect: The toolbar has transform: translateZ(0), which makes it a stacking context at z-index 0, so the badge's z-index:100 is trapped inside it and the following .promo strip (position:relative; z-index:1; margin-top:-18px) paints over the whole badge.

brief: The hero banner wipes in from left to right over 700ms as the page loads, ending fully shown.
Clicking the x on the toast fades it out over 300ms while it sinks slightly, and then it is gone.
defect: The click handler starts element.animate() for the fade and then sets style.display='none' in the same task, so the toast is removed from rendering at once and the exit animation never shows.

brief: Clicking Dismiss fades the announcement panel out over 250ms, after which it is gone.
On load the offer card slides in horizontally from the left and fades in, staying on one line.
defect: The element.animate() keyframes start at translate: '-360px 48px' — a stray 48px Y offset — so the card rises diagonally instead of sliding horizontally.

brief: Clicking Add to cart sends an orange dot arcing up and over to the cart on the right, where it stays.
Hovering a settings row nudges its chevron 6px to the right.
defect: The chevron transitions inset-inline-start but is position: static, where inset properties have no effect, so nothing moves.

brief: Shortly after load the snackbar rises up from below the bottom edge of the screen into place.
On load the welcome card slides in from the left and fades in.
The pricing card pops in on load, and grows slightly when you hover it.
defect: The entrance element.animate() on scale uses fill: 'forwards', so after it finishes the animation keeps holding scale: 1 and overrides the :hover rule's scale: 1.06.

brief: The card rises into place on load; hovering it then grows it slightly in place.
Clicking the switch slides its knob smoothly to the right over 250ms.
defect: The knob's translate reads var(--pos) and the rule transitions --pos, but --pos is not registered, so it interpolates discretely and the knob jumps.

brief: Clicking the switch slides its knob smoothly to the right over 250ms.
Clicking the account button opens its menu, which fades in and slides down a few pixels over 200ms.
defect: The menu goes from display:none ([hidden]) to display:block with only opacity/translate transitions and no @starting-style, so there is no before-style to transition from and it pops in.

brief: Clicking Share brings up a bottom sheet that rises up into place and fades in over 300ms.
Clicking Sync now spins the sync icon once, clockwise, in place.
defect: The rotation is applied to .icon-wrap, a display:block span as wide as the card (552px), so its default centre origin is ~276px right of the icon and the icon swings around a large circle.

brief: The hanging OPEN sign swings back and forth from its hook at the top, twice, then hangs still.
When the page loads the cookie banner slides down from above the top edge into place.
defect: In 'animation: banner-drop 400 ease-out both' the unitless 400 is read as animation-iteration-count, not a duration, so the duration stays 0s and the both-filled animation sits at its end state from the first frame: nothing ever slides.

brief: The status pill changes from grey to green over one second and stays exactly where it is.
The loading ring spins clockwise in place, smoothly and forever.
defect: The element.animate() keyframes go from rotate 0deg to 330deg with iterations: Infinity, so every loop snaps 30deg back to the start — a visible seam.

brief: The eight-dot loader ticks round clockwise in eight jumps per turn, forever, in place.
The four activity rows fade up into place one after another, 80ms apart, each taking 400ms.
Clicking Menu slides the navigation drawer in from the left edge, easing out over 300ms.
Hovering the article card lifts it 4px over 150ms, with a softer, larger shadow.
Clicking Upload fills the progress bar from the left to 70% over 600ms, easing in and out.
